title: ISMP S5 client-side Modpack
description: Client-side Modpack for member of ISMP S5. Barebones, only includes what is absolutely necessary.
body:
Client-side modpack for ISMP S5 members, contains only the mods required to connect to the server. **NOT** for singleplayer use; for the full experience go --> **[here](https://modrinth.com/modpack/ismp-s5-singleplayer-and-server-modpack)** <-- instead.

ISMP S5 is a **fantasy and magic** themed SMP built around **[Enchancement](https://modrinth.com/mod/enchancement)**'s overhauled enchanting system, with a focus on exploration through custom biomes, structures, mobs, weapon, etc. (you get the point). Install this modpack to join the official server (if you're whitelisted of course XD). It's recommended to add your own performance mods like Sodium since I don't bundle anything other than the absolute necessary mods needed. It is highly recommended to use --> **[JEI (Just Enough Items)](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei)** <-- so you can see the recipes of custom items. There is also **[Simple Voice Chat]([https://modrinth.com/mod/jei](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-voice-chat))** integration.

# Notes: 
-While I try to keep this up to date the mods may not always be on the latest version (I try my best ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ ).
-Configs may not be matched to the server (only one that I know of being enchancement everything else I think is default), if you get an enchancement config error paste this into the config file:
